description: Defines the DocumentVersion class representing a version of an uploaded document, including OCR data and key fields.

classes.name: DocumentVersion
classes.description: Represents a specific uploaded document version with metadata, OCR data, and key fields.

methods.name: getVersionId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this document version.

methods.name: setVersionId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of this document version.

methods.name: getVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the version number of the document.

methods.name: setVersionNumber
methods.description: Sets the version number of the document.

methods.name: getUploadedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the document version was uploaded.

methods.name: setUploadedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the document version was uploaded.

methods.name: getOriginalFileName
methods.description: Returns the original filename of the uploaded document.

methods.name: setOriginalFileName
methods.description: Sets the original filename of the uploaded document.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the uploaded file.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getSizeBytes
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setSizeBytes
methods.description: Sets the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: getStoragePath
methods.description: Returns the storage location reference of the file.

methods.name: setStoragePath
methods.description: Sets the storage location reference of the file.

methods.name: getOcr
methods.description: Returns the OCR result associated with this document version.

methods.name: setOcr
methods.description: Sets the OCR result associated with this document version.

methods.name: getKeyFields
methods.description: Returns key extracted fields such as total, date, vendor, tax, etc.

methods.name: setKeyFields
methods.description: Sets key extracted fields such as total, date, vendor, tax, etc.
